name: Capstone 1
description: Students develop an understanding of a multidisciplinary design process and experience through working in teams across pillars to design and construct models or prototypes. The Capstone Programme is an integrated design experience for senior year undergraduate students from the five degree programmes (ASD, CSD, DAI, EPD and ESD); each project involves students from at least two different degree programmes as a team-based effort of 5 to 7 students working to solve real-world design challenges.
